name: Lyon-Saint Exupéry

runway.v: Longest runway 4,000 m x 45 m (17/35). AIP copy (2025): 17R/35L 4,000 m x 45 m, 17L/35R 2,670 m x 45 m.

customs.v: Immigration and customs 24/7, no prior notice.

fuel.quote: open 24 hours a day - 7 days a week

slots.v: Every IFR movement needs a prior slot request to COHOR (2025 AIP copy).
slots.quote: Any IFR movement at LYON SAINT EXUPERY must be subject to a prior request from COHOR association.

noise.v: Noisiest chapter 3 jets (cumulative margin under 13 EPNdB) may not land or take off 22:00-06:00 local (2025 AIP copy).
noise.quote: to land between 2200 and 0600, touchdown local time,

handling.v: Handlers listed in the 2025 AIP copy; the airport also runs VINCI Airports Executive Handling.

notes: Current AIP AD 2 LFLL could not be opened (SIA edition pages failed). Runway, customs and fuel from the airport operator's business aviation page (2026); COHOR slots, night noise rule and handlers from the DIRCAM copy of the AIP (AIRAC 06/25, 12 Jun 2025) and must be rechecked. No full curfew was found; only the noisiest jets are barred at night.
